layer: Vertically integrated home humanoid + embodied AI; industrial partnerships
valuation_basis: Reported SoftBank majority-stake acquisition talks, not closed or primary-verified; Reuters could not confirm
total_capital_basis: Current lifetime total not verified; January 2024 primary release stated >$125M in less than 12 months, not current total
latest_round_basis: Historical latest primary disclosed sized round located, outside window; current page Jan13 conflicts with legacy Jan11; not a claim that no later financing occurred
revenue_signal: Revenue: not disclosed. $20,000 ownership / $499 monthly subscription advertised; $200 refundable reservation deposit, not revenue.
customers: Consumers unnamed; EQT portfolio access framework and IFS development partnership, not confirmed deployed customer fleet.
scale: Company-reported 10,000 NEO/year capacity ramp; 100,000+/year end-2027 target; complete external customer deliveries not verified.
top_risk: Home autonomy and expert-service economics remain unverified at customer scale; financing status unclear.
momentum_basis: Analyst judgment: dated factory/model/hand advances, unresolved independent deliveries and closed valuation.

Do not treat 10,000 annual robot capacity or 10,000 hands of component capacity as deliveries.

Customer delivery count is unverified, not proven zero.
January 2024 current company funding page says Jan13; legacy copy says Jan11.

limitations: No physical robot testing or customer interviews.
